contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GENIO POP ROM ; D/ IMP LICINIVS P F AVG

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Licinius I, AD 308-324 (Reece period 15). Reverse legend reads GENIO POP ROM. Reverse shows Genius standing facing left with corn measure on his head holding a cornucopia. Mint is Trier. RIC VII, p. 173, no. 121. Obverse shows Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads IMP LICINIVS P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: T/F//BTR. Die axis is 6…
